# AUTO-GENERATED by DI Updater Tool. Do not edit.


# Root remains the player; each domicile is saved before returning to root.
DI_dm_add_candidate_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { exists = owner owner = { is_alive = yes } }
        save_scope_as = DI_dm_candidate
        scope:DI_dm_player = {
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = DI_dm_candidates target = scope:DI_dm_candidate } } }
                add_to_variable_list = { name = DI_dm_candidates target = scope:DI_dm_candidate }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_dm_recount_effect = {
    set_variable = { name = DI_dm_candidate_count value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = DI_dm_selected_count value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = DI_dm_shown_count value = 0 }
    every_in_list = {
        variable = DI_dm_candidates
        scope:DI_dm_player = { change_variable = { name = DI_dm_candidate_count add = 1 } }
    }
    every_in_list = {
        variable = DI_dm_selected
        scope:DI_dm_player = { change_variable = { name = DI_dm_selected_count add = 1 } }
    }
    every_in_list = {
        variable = DI_dm_shown
        scope:DI_dm_player = { change_variable = { name = DI_dm_shown_count add = 1 } }
    }
}

# Re-resolve characters and held titles before every action. A transferred,
# destroyed, or replaced domicile cannot survive solely as a stale selection.
DI_dm_refresh_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = DI_dm_changed_count } }
        set_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count value = 0 }
    }
    clear_variable_list = DI_dm_candidates
    every_in_list = {
        variable = DI_dm_sources
        limit = { is_alive = yes }
        domicile ?= { DI_dm_add_candidate_effect = yes }
        every_held_title = { title_domicile ?= { DI_dm_add_candidate_effect = yes } }
    }
    clear_variable_list = DI_dm_retained
    every_in_list = {
        variable = DI_dm_selected
        limit = { exists = owner owner = { is_alive = yes } }
        save_scope_as = DI_dm_candidate
        scope:DI_dm_player = {
            if = {
                limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = DI_dm_candidates target = scope:DI_dm_candidate } }
                add_to_variable_list = { name = DI_dm_retained target = scope:DI_dm_candidate }
            }
        }
    }
    clear_variable_list = DI_dm_selected
    every_in_list = {
        variable = DI_dm_retained
        save_scope_as = DI_dm_candidate
        scope:DI_dm_player = { add_to_variable_list = { name = DI_dm_selected target = scope:DI_dm_candidate } }
    }
    clear_variable_list = DI_dm_retained
    DI_dm_ensure_filter_effect = yes
    DI_dm_update_shown_effect = yes
    DI_dm_recount_effect = yes
}

            scope:DI_dm_player = { change_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count add = 1 } }
        }
    }
}

        limit = { DI_dm_can_add_merchant_company_exchange_02 = yes }
        DI_dm_add_merchant_company_exchange_01_effect = yes
        if = {
            limit = { has_domicile_building = merchant_company_exchange_01 }
            add_domicile_building = merchant_company_exchange_02
            if = {
                limit = { has_domicile_building = merchant_company_exchange_02 }
                scope:DI_dm_player = { change_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count add = 1 } }
            }
        }
    }
}

        limit = { DI_dm_can_add_merc_yurt_05 = yes }
        DI_dm_add_merc_yurt_04_effect = yes
        if = {
            limit = { has_domicile_building = merc_yurt_04 }
            add_domicile_building = merc_yurt_05
            if = {
                limit = { has_domicile_building = merc_yurt_05 }
                scope:DI_dm_player = { change_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count add = 1 } }
            }
        }
    }
}

        limit = { DI_dm_can_add_merchant_company_chapel_05_spiritual = yes }
        DI_dm_add_merchant_company_chapel_04_spiritual_effect = yes
        if = {
            limit = { has_domicile_building = merchant_company_chapel_04_spiritual }
            add_domicile_building = merchant_company_chapel_05_spiritual
            if = {
                limit = { has_domicile_building = merchant_company_chapel_05_spiritual }
                scope:DI_dm_player = { change_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count add = 1 } }
            }
        }
    }
}

        limit = { DI_dm_can_add_merchant_company_goldsmiths_row_05 = yes }
        DI_dm_add_merchant_company_goldsmiths_row_04_effect = yes
        if = {
            limit = { has_domicile_building = merchant_company_goldsmiths_row_04 }
            add_domicile_building = merchant_company_goldsmiths_row_05
            if = {
                limit = { has_domicile_building = merchant_company_goldsmiths_row_05 }
                scope:DI_dm_player = { change_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count add = 1 } }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_dm_lower_to_accolade_yurt_01_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_domicile_building_or_higher = accolade_yurt_02 }
        DI_dm_lower_to_accolade_yurt_02_effect = yes
        if = {
            limit = { has_domicile_building = accolade_yurt_02 }
            lower_domicile_building_no_refund = accolade_yurt_02
            if = {
                limit = { has_domicile_building = accolade_yurt_01 }
                scope:DI_dm_player = { change_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count add = 1 } }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_dm_set_accolade_yurt_01_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = owner
            owner = { is_alive = yes }
            has_ongoing_domicile_construction = no
            OR = { is_domicile_type = yurt }
        }
        DI_dm_lower_to_accolade_yurt_01_effect = yes
        DI_dm_add_accolade_yurt_01_effect = yes
    }
}

DI_dm_remove_accolade_yurt_01_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = owner
            owner = { is_alive = yes }
            has_ongoing_domicile_construction = no
            OR = { is_domicile_type = yurt }
            has_domicile_building = accolade_yurt_01
        }
        remove_domicile_building_no_refund = accolade_yurt_01
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_domicile_building = accolade_yurt_01 } }
            scope:DI_dm_player = { change_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count add = 1 } }
        }
    }
}

        limit = { has_domicile_building_or_higher = baggage_train_02 }
        DI_dm_lower_to_baggage_train_02_effect = yes
        if = {
            limit = { has_domicile_building = baggage_train_02 }
            lower_domicile_building_no_refund = baggage_train_02
            if = {
                limit = { has_domicile_building = baggage_train_01 }
                scope:DI_dm_player = { change_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count add = 1 } }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_dm_set_baggage_train_01_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = owner
            owner = { is_alive = yes }
            has_ongoing_domicile_construction = no
            OR = { is_domicile_type = camp }
        }
        DI_dm_lower_to_baggage_train_01_effect = yes
        DI_dm_add_baggage_train_01_effect = yes
    }
}

DI_dm_remove_baggage_train_01_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = owner
            owner = { is_alive = yes }
            has_ongoing_domicile_construction = no
            OR = { is_domicile_type = camp }
            has_domicile_building = baggage_train_01
        }
        DI_dm_remove_baggage_train_ample_steeds_effect = yes
        DI_dm_remove_baggage_train_ascetics_effect = yes
        DI_dm_remove_baggage_train_bartering_grounds_effect = yes
        DI_dm_remove_baggage_train_kennel_effect = yes
        DI_dm_remove_baggage_train_negotiators_effect = yes
        DI_dm_remove_baggage_train_pleasure_tents_effect = yes
        DI_dm_remove_baggage_train_porters_effect = yes
        DI_dm_remove_baggage_train_proof_of_claims_effect = yes
        DI_dm_remove_baggage_train_ransom_cages_effect = yes
        DI_dm_remove_baggage_train_scribes_effect = yes
        DI_dm_remove_baggage_train_shrine_effect = yes
        DI_dm_remove_baggage_train_siege_engineers_effect = yes
        DI_dm_remove_baggage_train_trackers_effect = yes
        remove_domicile_building_no_refund = baggage_train_01
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_domicile_building = baggage_train_01 } }
            scope:DI_dm_player = { change_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count add = 1 } }
        }
    }
}

        limit = { has_domicile_building_or_higher = baptistery_holy_font_02 }
        DI_dm_lower_to_baptistery_holy_font_02_effect = yes
        if = {
            limit = { has_domicile_building = baptistery_holy_font_02 }
            lower_domicile_building_no_refund = baptistery_holy_font_02
            if = {
                limit = { has_domicile_building = baptistery_holy_font_01 }
                scope:DI_dm_player = { change_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count add = 1 } }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_dm_set_baptistery_holy_font_01_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = owner
            owner = { is_alive = yes }
            has_ongoing_domicile_construction = no
            OR = { is_domicile_type = ecclesiastical_domicile }
        }
        DI_dm_lower_to_baptistery_holy_font_01_effect = yes
        DI_dm_add_baptistery_holy_font_01_effect = yes
    }
}

DI_dm_remove_baptistery_holy_font_01_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = owner
            owner = { is_alive = yes }
            has_ongoing_domicile_construction = no
            OR = { is_domicile_type = ecclesiastical_domicile }
            has_domicile_building = baptistery_holy_font_01
        }
        remove_domicile_building_no_refund = baptistery_holy_font_01
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_domicile_building = baptistery_holy_font_01 } }
            scope:DI_dm_player = { change_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count add = 1 } }
        }
    }
}

    }

DI_dm_remove_barber_tent_01_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = owner
            owner = { is_alive = yes }
            has_ongoing_domicile_construction = no
            OR = { is_domicile_type = camp }
            has_domicile_building = barber_tent_01
        }
        DI_dm_remove_barber_tent_dentists_tools_effect = yes
        DI_dm_remove_barber_tent_morticians_tools_effect = yes
        DI_dm_remove_barber_tent_reference_corpus_effect = yes
        DI_dm_remove_barber_tent_surgeons_tools_effect = yes
        DI_dm_remove_barber_tent_torturers_tools_effect = yes
        remove_domicile_building_no_refund = barber_tent_01
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_domicile_building = barber_tent_01 } }
            scope:DI_dm_player = { change_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count add = 1 } }
        }

        }

        limit = {
            exists = owner
            owner = { is_alive = yes }
            has_ongoing_domicile_construction = no
            OR = { is_domicile_type = ecclesiastical_domicile }
        }
        DI_dm_lower_to_cathedral_crypt_02_effect = yes
        DI_dm_add_cathedral_crypt_02_effect = yes
    }
}

DI_dm_remove_cathedral_crypt_02_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = owner
            owner = { is_alive = yes }
            has_ongoing_domicile_construction = no
            OR = { is_domicile_type = ecclesiastical_domicile }
            has_domicile_building = cathedral_crypt_02
        }
        remove_domicile_building_no_refund = cathedral_crypt_02
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_domicile_building = cathedral_crypt_02 } }
            scope:DI_dm_player = { change_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count add = 1 } }
        }
    }
}

DI_dm_lower_to_cathedral_crypt_03_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_domicile_building_or_higher = cathedral_crypt_04 }

        limit = { has_domicile_building_or_higher = falconry_yurt_04 }
        DI_dm_lower_to_falconry_yurt_04_effect = yes
        if = {
            limit = { has_domicile_building = falconry_yurt_04 }
            lower_domicile_building_no_refund = falconry_yurt_04
            if = {
                limit = { has_domicile_building = falconry_yurt_03 }
                scope:DI_dm_player = { change_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count add = 1 } }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_dm_set_falconry_yurt_03_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = owner
            owner = { is_alive = yes }
            has_ongoing_domicile_construction = no
            OR = { is_domicile_type = yurt }
        }
        DI_dm_lower_to_falconry_yurt_03_effect = yes
        DI_dm_add_falconry_yurt_03_effect = yes
    }
}

DI_dm_remove_falconry_yurt_03_effect = {

        }

        limit = { has_domicile_building_or_higher = fertility_mystical_yurt_06 }
        DI_dm_lower_to_fertility_mystical_yurt_06_effect = yes
        if = {
            limit = { has_domicile_building = fertility_mystical_yurt_06 }
            lower_domicile_building_no_refund = fertility_mystical_yurt_06
            if = {
                limit = { has_domicile_building = fertility_mystical_yurt_05 }
                scope:DI_dm_player = { change_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count add = 1 } }
            }
        }
    }
}

        }
        DI_dm_lower_to_herd_trade_yurt_04_effect = yes
        DI_dm_add_herd_trade_yurt_04_effect = yes
    }
}

    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = owner

            OR = { is_domicile_type = yurt }

        }
    }

DI_dm_set_hostage_ward_yurt_06_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = owner
            owner = { is_alive = yes }
            has_ongoing_domicile_construction = no
            OR = { is_domicile_type = yurt }
        }
        DI_dm_lower_to_hostage_ward_yurt_06_effect = yes
        DI_dm_add_hostage_ward_yurt_06_effect = yes
    }
}

DI_dm_remove_hostage_ward_yurt_06_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = owner
            owner = { is_alive = yes }
            has_ongoing_domicile_construction = no
            OR = { is_domicile_type = yurt }
            has_domicile_building = hostage_ward_yurt_06
        }
        remove_domicile_building_no_refund = hostage_ward_yurt_06
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_domicile_building = hostage_ward_yurt_06 } }
            scope:DI_dm_player = { change_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count add = 1 } }
        }
    }
}

        limit = { has_domicile_building_or_higher = japanese_fields_06 }
        DI_dm_lower_to_japanese_fields_06_effect = yes
        if = {
            limit = { has_domicile_building = japanese_fields_06 }
            lower_domicile_building_no_refund = japanese_fields_06
            if = {
                limit = { has_domicile_building = japanese_fields_05 }
                scope:DI_dm_player = { change_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count add = 1 } }
            }
        }
    }
}

        limit = { has_domicile_building_or_higher = japanese_manor_library_confucian_02 }
        DI_dm_lower_to_japanese_manor_library_confucian_02_effect = yes
        if = {
            limit = { has_domicile_building = japanese_manor_library_confucian_02 }
            lower_domicile_building_no_refund = japanese_manor_library_confucian_02
            if = {
                limit = { has_domicile_building = japanese_manor_library_confucian_01 }
                scope:DI_dm_player = { change_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count add = 1 } }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_dm_set_japanese_manor_library_confucian_01_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = owner
            owner = { is_alive = yes }
            has_ongoing_domicile_construction = no
            OR = { is_domicile_type = japanese_manor }
        }
        DI_dm_lower_to_japanese_manor_library_confucian_01_effect = yes
        DI_dm_add_japanese_manor_library_confucian_01_effect = yes
    }
}

DI_dm_remove_japanese_manor_library_confucian_01_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = owner
            owner = { is_alive = yes }
            has_ongoing_domicile_construction = no
            OR = { is_domicile_type = japanese_manor }
            has_domicile_building = japanese_manor_library_confucian_01
        }
        remove_domicile_building_no_refund = japanese_manor_library_confucian_01
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_domicile_building = japanese_manor_library_confucian_01 } }
            scope:DI_dm_player = { change_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count add = 1 } }
        }
    }
}

        limit = {
            exists = owner
            owner = { is_alive = yes }
            has_ongoing_domicile_construction = no
            OR = { is_domicile_type = japanese_manor }
            has_domicile_building = japanese_manor_office_05
        }
        remove_domicile_building_no_refund = japanese_manor_office_05
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_domicile_building = japanese_manor_office_05 } }
            scope:DI_dm_player = { change_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count add = 1 } }
        }
    }
}

DI_dm_lower_to_merchant_company_building_civic_04_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_domicile_building_or_higher = merchant_company_building_civic_05_knights }
        DI_dm_lower_to_merchant_company_building_civic_05_knights_effect = yes
        if = {
            limit = { has_domicile_building = merchant_company_building_civic_05_knights }
            lower_domicile_building_no_refund = merchant_company_building_civic_05_knights
            if = {
                limit = { has_domicile_building = merchant_company_building_civic_04 }
                scope:DI_dm_player = { change_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count add = 1 } }
            }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_domicile_building_or_higher = merchant_company_building_civic_05_stress }
        DI_dm_lower_to_merchant_company_building_civic_05_stress_effect = yes
        if = {
            limit = { has_domicile_building = merchant_company_building_civic_05_stress }
            lower_domicile_building_no_refund = merchant_company_building_civic_05_stress
            if = {
                limit = { has_domicile_building = merchant_company_building_civic_04 }
                scope:DI_dm_player = { change_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count add = 1 } }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_dm_set_merchant_company_building_civic_04_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = owner

        DI_dm_add_merchant_company_building_civic_04_effect = yes

DI_dm_lower_to_merchant_company_building_production_01_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_domicile_building_or_higher = merchant_company_building_production_02 }
        DI_dm_lower_to_merchant_company_building_production_02_effect = yes
        if = {
            limit = { has_domicile_building = merchant_company_building_production_02 }
            lower_domicile_building_no_refund = merchant_company_building_production_02
            if = {
                limit = { has_domicile_building = merchant_company_building_production_01 }
                scope:DI_dm_player = { change_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count add = 1 } }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_dm_set_merchant_company_building_production_01_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = owner
            owner = { is_alive = yes }
            has_ongoing_domicile_construction = no
            OR = { is_domicile_type = merchant_company }
        }
        DI_dm_lower_to_merchant_company_building_production_01_effect = yes
        DI_dm_add_merchant_company_building_production_01_effect = yes
    }
}

DI_dm_lower_to_merchant_company_building_production_02_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_domicile_building_or_higher = merchant_company_building_production_03 }
        DI_dm_lower_to_merchant_company_building_production_03_effect = yes
        if = {
            limit = { has_domicile_building = merchant_company_building_production_03 }
            lower_domicile_building_no_refund = merchant_company_building_production_03
            if = {
                limit = { has_domicile_building = merchant_company_building_production_02 }
                scope:DI_dm_player = { change_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count add = 1 } }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_dm_set_merchant_company_building_production_02_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = owner
            owner = { is_alive = yes }
            has_ongoing_domicile_construction = no
            OR = { is_domicile_type = merchant_company }
        }
        DI_dm_lower_to_merchant_company_building_production_02_effect = yes
        DI_dm_add_merchant_company_building_production_02_effect = yes
    }
}

DI_dm_lower_to_merchant_company_building_production_03_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_domicile_building_or_higher = merchant_company_building_production_04 }
        DI_dm_lower_to_merchant_company_building_production_04_effect = yes
        if = {
            limit = { has_domicile_building = merchant_company_building_production_04 }
            lower_domicile_building_no_refund = merchant_company_building_production_04
            if = {
                limit = { has_domicile_building = merchant_company_building_production_03 }
                scope:DI_dm_player = { change_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count add = 1 } }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_dm_set_merchant_company_building_production_03_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = owner
            owner = { is_alive = yes }
            has_ongoing_domicile_construction = no
            OR = { is_domicile_type = merchant_company }
        }
        DI_dm_lower_to_merchant_company_building_production_03_effect = yes
        DI_dm_add_merchant_company_building_production_03_effect = yes
    }
}

DI_dm_lower_to_merchant_company_building_production_04_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_domicile_building_or_higher = merchant_company_building_production_05_income }
        DI_dm_lower_to_merchant_company_building_production_05_income_effect = yes
        if = {
            limit = { has_domicile_building = merchant_company_building_production_05_income }
            lower_domicile_building_no_refund = merchant_company_building_production_05_income
            if = {
                limit = { has_domicile_building = merchant_company_building_production_04 }
                scope:DI_dm_player = { change_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count add = 1 } }
            }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_domicile_building_or_higher = merchant_company_building_production_05_prestige }
        DI_dm_lower_to_merchant_company_building_production_05_prestige_effect = yes
        if = {
            limit = { has_domicile_building = merchant_company_building_production_05_prestige }
            lower_domicile_building_no_refund = merchant_company_building_production_05_prestige
            if = {
                limit = { has_domicile_building = merchant_company_building_production_04 }
                scope:DI_dm_player = { change_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count add = 1 } }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_dm_set_merchant_company_building_production_04_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = owner

            has_ongoing_domicile_construction = no

DI_dm_lower_to_merchant_company_building_production_05_prestige_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_domicile_building_or_higher = merchant_company_building_production_06_prestige }
        DI_dm_lower_to_merchant_company_building_production_06_prestige_effect = yes
        if = {
            limit = { has_domicile_building = merchant_company_building_production_06_prestige }
            lower_domicile_building_no_refund = merchant_company_building_production_06_prestige
            if = {
                limit = { has_domicile_building = merchant_company_building_production_05_prestige }
                scope:DI_dm_player = { change_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count add = 1 } }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_dm_set_merchant_company_building_production_05_prestige_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = owner
            owner = { is_alive = yes }
            has_ongoing_domicile_construction = no
            OR = { is_domicile_type = merchant_company }
        }
        DI_dm_lower_to_merchant_company_building_production_05_prestige_effect = yes
        DI_dm_add_merchant_company_building_production_05_prestige_effect = yes
    }
}

        limit = {

        limit = { has_domicile_building_or_higher = merchant_company_cereals_traders_02 }
        DI_dm_lower_to_merchant_company_cereals_traders_02_effect = yes
        if = {
            limit = { has_domicile_building = merchant_company_cereals_traders_02 }
            lower_domicile_building_no_refund = merchant_company_cereals_traders_02
            if = {
                limit = { has_domicile_building = merchant_company_cereals_traders_01 }
                scope:DI_dm_player = { change_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count add = 1 } }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_dm_set_merchant_company_cereals_traders_01_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = owner
            owner = { is_alive = yes }
            has_ongoing_domicile_construction = no
            OR = { is_domicile_type = merchant_company }
        }
        DI_dm_lower_to_merchant_company_cereals_traders_01_effect = yes
        DI_dm_add_merchant_company_cereals_traders_01_effect = yes
    }
}

DI_dm_remove_merchant_company_cereals_traders_01_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = owner
            owner = { is_alive = yes }
            has_ongoing_domicile_construction = no
            OR = { is_domicile_type = merchant_company }
            has_domicile_building = merchant_company_cereals_traders_01
        }
        remove_domicile_building_no_refund = merchant_company_cereals_traders_01
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_domicile_building = merchant_company_cereals_traders_01 } }
            scope:DI_dm_player = { change_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count add = 1 } }
        }
    }
}

        limit = { has_domicile_building_or_higher = merchant_company_orchard_house_03 }
        DI_dm_lower_to_merchant_company_orchard_house_03_effect = yes
        if = {
            limit = { has_domicile_building = merchant_company_orchard_house_03 }
            lower_domicile_building_no_refund = merchant_company_orchard_house_03
            if = {
                limit = { has_domicile_building = merchant_company_orchard_house_02 }
                scope:DI_dm_player = { change_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count add = 1 } }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_dm_set_merchant_company_orchard_house_02_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = owner
            owner = { is_alive = yes }
            has_ongoing_domicile_construction = no
            OR = { is_domicile_type = merchant_company }
        }
        DI_dm_lower_to_merchant_company_orchard_house_02_effect = yes
        DI_dm_add_merchant_company_orchard_house_02_effect = yes
    }
}

DI_dm_remove_merchant_company_orchard_house_02_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = owner
            owner = { is_alive = yes }
            has_ongoing_domicile_construction = no
            OR = { is_domicile_type = merchant_company }
            has_domicile_building = merchant_company_orchard_house_02
        }
        remove_domicile_building_no_refund = merchant_company_orchard_house_02
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_domicile_building = merchant_company_orchard_house_02 } }
            scope:DI_dm_player = { change_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count add = 1 } }
        }
    }
}

        limit = {
            exists = owner
            owner = { is_alive = yes }
            has_ongoing_domicile_construction = no
            OR = { is_domicile_type = ecclesiastical_domicile }
            has_domicile_building = school_tutors_quarters_02
        }
        remove_domicile_building_no_refund = school_tutors_quarters_02
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_domicile_building = school_tutors_quarters_02 } }
            scope:DI_dm_player = { change_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count add = 1 } }
        }
    }
}

DI_dm_ensure_filter_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:DI_dm_filter_schema ?= 16001340 } }
        clear_variable_list = DI_dm_filter_choices
        add_to_variable_list = { name = DI_dm_filter_choices target = flag:DI_dm_filter_all }
        add_to_variable_list = { name = DI_dm_filter_choices target = flag:DI_dm_filter_type_camp }
        add_to_variable_list = { name = DI_dm_filter_choices target = flag:DI_dm_filter_type_east_asian_estate }
        add_to_variable_list = { name = DI_dm_filter_choices target = flag:DI_dm_filter_type_ecclesiastical_domicile }
        add_to_variable_list = { name = DI_dm_filter_choices target = flag:DI_dm_filter_type_estate }
        add_to_variable_list = { name = DI_dm_filter_choices target = flag:DI_dm_filter_type_japanese_manor }
        add_to_variable_list = { name = DI_dm_filter_choices target = flag:DI_dm_filter_type_merchant_company }
        add_to_variable_list = { name = DI_dm_filter_choices target = flag:DI_dm_filter_type_yurt }
        set_variable = { name = DI_dm_filter_schema value = 16001340 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = DI_dm_filter_choice } }
        set_variable = { name = DI_dm_filter_choice value = flag:DI_dm_filter_all }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { OR = { var:DI_dm_filter_choice = flag:DI_dm_filter_all var:DI_dm_filter_choice = flag:DI_dm_filter_type_camp var:DI_dm_filter_choice = flag:DI_dm_filter_type_east_asian_estate var:DI_dm_filter_choice = flag:DI_dm_filter_type_ecclesiastical_domicile var:DI_dm_filter_choice = flag:DI_dm_filter_type_estate var:DI_dm_filter_choice = flag:DI_dm_filter_type_japanese_manor var:DI_dm_filter_choice = flag:DI_dm_filter_type_merchant_company var:DI_dm_filter_choice = flag:DI_dm_filter_type_yurt } } }
        set_variable = { name = DI_dm_filter_choice value = flag:DI_dm_filter_all }
    }
}

DI_dm_update_shown_effect = {
    clear_variable_list = DI_dm_shown
    every_in_list = {
        variable = DI_dm_candidates
        limit = { exists = owner owner = { is_alive = yes } DI_dm_matches_filter = yes }
        save_scope_as = DI_dm_candidate
        scope:DI_dm_player = { add_to_variable_list = { name = DI_dm_shown target = scope:DI_dm_candidate } }
    }
}
